+    """Generate n-bit fingerprints for each k-character shingle in text.
+    Uses SHA-256 to hash each shingle, then truncates to n bits.
+    """
+    text = text.lower().strip()
+    fps = []

+        digest = hashlib.sha256(shingle.encode()).digest()
+        # Use first 16 bytes of SHA-256 for our fingerprint
+        fp = digest[:16]
+        fps.append(fp)
+        i = i + 1
